title: Norway greenlights first full-scale ship tunnel
summary: Norway has officially approved the construction of the world's first full-scale ship tunnel, the Stad Ship Tunnel, which will allow vessels to bypass the dangerous Stadhavet Sea. The 1.7km tunnel in the Møre og Romsdal county will accommodate ships up to 17,000 gross tons.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of ships having to navigate through the treacherous and weather-prone Stadhavet Sea, which has caused numerous accidents and delays.
why_valuable: This pioneering infrastructure project will significantly improve maritime safety, reduce voyage times, and serve as a model for future large-scale maritime civil engineering projects worldwide.
